info.title: Crosmos Memory API
info.description: Agent memory system with hybrid retrieval

post.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.

Revoke a refresh token so it can no longer be exchanged.

Access tokens remain valid until their natural expiry — clients
should discard them on logout.
Expired or invalid tokens return 204 (idempotent): the caller's
intent is already satisfied.

get.description: List all API keys for the authenticated user.

post.description:
Create a new API key for programmatic access.

The raw key is shown once — store it securely.
Set the user's active organization, returning a new JWT with the claim.

get.description:
Get the authorization URL for the given provider.

The client should redirect the user to this URL. After the user
consents, the provider will redirect back to ``redirect_uri``
with a ``code`` and ``state`` parameter.

post.description:
Exchange an authorization code for JWT tokens.

The client sends the ``code`` received from the provider redirect
along with the ``state`` it received from the authorize step.
Create a new memory space within an organization.

get.description: List all memory spaces in the user's active organization.
Get a memory space by ID.

delete.description: Delete a memory space and all its contents (cascading).

post.description:
Search memories using hybrid retrieval.

Combines semantic (vector), keyword (full-text), and graph-based retrieval
using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) for result fusion.

post.description:
Accept content for ingestion into the knowledge graph.

Validates input, stores raw Source rows, enqueues a background
ingestion job, and returns 202 Accepted with a job_id for polling.
